entries.msgid: This is the front door, not the library visualiser. The full library/ visualiser is bean jbx2 and is being built separately. This page mocks the IRIS home page and links onward rather than becoming a second answer to the same question.

entries.msgid: Three routes to one item, which is the point. The catalogue knows this item once; the bytes are reachable upstream at WHO, here as a replica page, and from a CDN edge — jsDelivr serves any public repository, so the last one costs this project no hosting at all. The KG says what exists and where; the CDN says nothing and just serves it.
entries.msgstr: Tres vías hacia un mismo ítem, y esa es la idea. El catálogo conoce este ítem una sola vez; los bytes son accesibles en origen en la OMS, aquí como página de réplica y desde un nodo de CDN; jsDelivr sirve cualquier repositorio público, así que la última no le cuesta a este proyecto ningún alojamiento. El grafo de conocimiento dice qué existe y dónde; la CDN no dice nada y simplemente lo sirve.
entries.back_translation: Three routes to one same item, and that is the idea. The catalogue knows this item only once; the bytes are accessible at source at WHO, here as a replica page and from a CDN node; jsDelivr serves any public repository, so the last one costs this project no hosting. The knowledge graph says what exists and where; the CDN says nothing and simply serves it.
findings: [term] 'CDN edge' came back as 'CDN node': 'edge' is the specific CDN term for a delivery point near the user, and 'node' is broader.

findings: [term] DSpace 'Item' column heading/badge rendered as 'Record', which in the same table collides with the 'Metadata record' column.

entries.msgid: Items in this Collection
entries.msgstr: Записи в этой коллекции
entries.back_translation: Records in this collection
findings: [term] DSpace 'Items in this Collection' rendered as 'Records in this collection' (item vs record).

entries.msgid: No materialized items or collections matched “{q}”.
entries.msgstr: Ни одна материализованная запись или коллекция не соответствует запросу «{q}».
entries.back_translation: No materialized record or collection matches the query "{q}".
findings: [term] 'materialized items' rendered as 'materialized record', colliding with the metadata record concept.

entries.msgid: no record, so nothing to render
entries.msgstr: записи нет, поэтому отображать нечего
entries.back_translation: there is no record, so there is nothing to display
findings: [sense] 'nothing to render' (generate XML/JSON-LD renderings) became 'nothing to display', shifting from producing output to showing it.

entries.msgid: none recorded — ingested from a local copy, not resolved from IRIS
entries.msgstr: не указан — импортировано из локальной копии, не разрешено через IRIS
entries.back_translation: not specified — imported from a local copy, not resolved via IRIS
findings: [term] 'ingested from a local copy' rendered as 'imported from a local copy' (ingest vs import).

entries.msgid: Permanent URI for this item
entries.msgstr: Постоянный URI этой записи
entries.back_translation: Persistent URI of this record
findings: [term] DSpace 'Permanent URI for this item' rendered as '... of this record' (item vs record).

entries.msgid: referenced
entries.msgstr: по ссылке
entries.back_translation: by reference
findings: [term] fixed materialisation-state name 'referenced' rendered as the phrase 'by reference', a mode rather than the state label.

entries.msgid: Search across {held} items held by value and referenced communities/collections. To look up any of the {referenced} referenced nodes by identifier, search here or open the {lookup}.
entries.msgstr: Поиск по записям, хранимым по значению ({held}), а также по сообществам и коллекциям, на которые есть ссылки. Чтобы найти по идентификатору любой из узлов, на которые есть ссылки ({referenced}), ищите здесь или откройте {lookup}.
entries.back_translation: Search the records held by value ({held}), as well as the communities and collections that are referenced. To find any of the referenced nodes ({referenced}) by identifier, search here or open {lookup}.
findings: [term] 'items held by value' rendered as 'records held by value' (item vs record).

entries.msgid: Search through the repository items and referenced identifier lookup
entries.msgstr: Поиск по записям репозитория и по идентификаторам узлов, на которые есть ссылки
entries.back_translation: Search the repository records and the identifiers of referenced nodes
findings: [term] 'repository items' rendered as 'repository records' (item vs record).

entries.msgid: Search through the repository’s {n} items
entries.msgstr: Поиск по записям репозитория (всего: {n})
entries.back_translation: Search the repository records (total: {n})
findings: [term] 'the repository's {n} items' rendered as 'repository records' (item vs record).

entries.msgid: Source of record: {iris} — © WHO. This copy asserts no endorsement and carries no WHO mark.
entries.msgstr: Первоисточник: {iris} — © ВОЗ. Эта копия не заявляет о каком-либо одобрении и не несёт никаких знаков ВОЗ.
entries.back_translation: Original source: {iris} — © WHO. This copy does not claim any endorsement and does not bear any WHO marks.
findings: [term] 'Source of record' (the authoritative source) rendered as 'Original source', losing the authoritative-record sense.

entries.msgid: Upstream IRIS reports {items} items across {files} files.
entries.msgstr: IRIS у первоисточника сообщает: записей — {items}, файлов — {files}.
entries.back_translation: IRIS at the original source reports: records — {items}, files — {files}.
findings: [term] 'items' rendered as 'records' (item vs record).

roundtrip-zh.summary: zh: 104 pass, 16 warn, 0 fail of 120. Back-translator tools: Read,Write. Each entry awaits a reviewer's ruling; nothing was auto-corrected.

entries.msgid: {nodes} nodes of a {items}-item {size} repository, of which {held} items are held here
entries.msgstr: 共 {nodes} 个节点，所属存储库有 {items} 个条目、容量 {size}，其中 {held} 个条目保存在此处
entries.back_translation: {nodes} nodes in total; the repository they belong to has {items} items and a capacity of {size}, of which {held} items are kept here
findings: [sense] 'a {size} repository' (its measured size) became 'a capacity of {size}', which a reader could take as the repository's maximum storage rather than its actual size.

entries.msgid: {nodes} nodes of a {items}-item {size} repository, of which 1 item is held here
entries.msgstr: 共 {nodes} 个节点，所属存储库有 {items} 个条目、容量 {size}，其中 1 个条目保存在此处
entries.back_translation: {nodes} nodes in total; the repository they belong to has {items} items and a capacity of {size}, of which 1 item is kept here
findings: [sense] 'a {size} repository' (its measured size) became 'a capacity of {size}', which a reader could take as maximum storage rather than actual size.

entries.msgid: {nodes} nodes of a repository of unmeasured size, of which {held} item(s) are held here
entries.msgstr: 共 {nodes} 个节点，所属存储库容量未经测量，其中 {held} 个条目保存在此处
entries.back_translation: {nodes} nodes in total; the capacity of the repository they belong to has not been measured; of these, {held} items are kept here
findings: [sense] 'repository of unmeasured size' became 'capacity ... has not been measured'; capacity (maximum) is not size (actual bytes held).

entries.msgid: {title} — ingested IRIS replica
entries.msgstr: {title} — 已收录的 IRIS 副本
entries.back_translation: {title} — included IRIS replica
findings: [term] 'ingested IRIS replica' rendered as 'included IRIS replica'; 'ingested' is a repository term of art (taken into the catalogue), and 'included' loses that technical sense.

entries.msgid: INGESTED COPY — not WHO, and not live. This page is rendered by {folioAssistant} from its own catalogue of {iris}, modelled by reference: {figures}. The WHO logo is deliberately omitted, and the rendered covers are withheld from display for the same reason — they carry the emblem printed on the publications.
entries.msgstr: 收录副本——并非世卫组织网站，也非实时内容。本页面由 {folioAssistant} 根据其自有的 {iris} 目录生成，该目录以引用方式建模：{figures}。世卫组织标志被刻意省略，生成的封面出于同样原因不予显示——封面上印有出版物上的会徽。
entries.back_translation: Included replica — not the WHO website, and not live content. This page was generated by {folioAssistant} from its own {iris} catalogue, which is modelled by reference: {figures}. The WHO logo is deliberately omitted, and the generated covers are not displayed for the same reason — the covers carry the emblem printed on the publication.
findings: [term] 'INGESTED COPY' rendered as 'Included replica', losing the term of art 'ingested'.
[sense] 'not WHO' narrowed to 'not the WHO website'; the source disclaims WHO authorship generally, not just the website.

entries.msgid: Ingested replica. Rendered from {catalogue} by {generator}. Layout after {iris}; every figure on this page is read out of the catalogue, not copied from a screenshot.
entries.msgstr: 收录副本。由 {generator} 根据 {catalogue} 生成。版式参照 {iris}；本页面上的每个数字都读取自目录，而非从屏幕截图复制。
entries.back_translation: Included replica. Generated by {generator} from {catalogue}. The layout follows {iris}; every number on this page is read from the catalogue, not copied from a screenshot.
findings: [term] 'Ingested replica' rendered as 'Included replica', losing the term of art 'ingested'.

entries.msgid: This is the front door, not the library visualiser. The full library/ visualiser is bean jbx2 and is being built separately. This page mocks the IRIS home page and links onward rather than becoming a second answer to the same question.
entries.msgstr: 这里是入口页，不是图书馆可视化工具。完整的 library/ 可视化工具是任务 jbx2，正在另行构建。本页面模仿 IRIS 首页并链接到其他页面，而不是成为同一问题的第二个答案。
entries.back_translation: This is an entry page, not the library visualization tool. The full library/ visualization tool is task jbx2, being built separately. This page imitates the IRIS home page and links to other pages, rather than becoming a second answer to the same problem.
findings: [term] 'bean' (this repository's defined work-item term) rendered generically as 'task', so the identifier jbx2 no longer reads as a bean ID.

entries.msgid: Where the held copies actually live — bean yl5w. The catalogue records each of these at uploads/<name>.pdf relative to who-iris/, and all three of those paths are missing: #477 moved library/ into this instance and left uploads/ in cat-harness/.
entries.msgstr: 保存的副本实际位于何处——任务 yl5w。目录将其中每一份都记录在相对于 who-iris/ 的 uploads/<name>.pdf，而这三个路径全部缺失：#477 将 library/ 移入了本实例，却把 uploads/ 留在了 cat-harness/。
entries.back_translation: Where the kept copies actually are — task yl5w. The catalogue records each of them at uploads/<name>.pdf relative to who-iris/, and all three of these paths are missing: #477 moved library/ into this instance but left uploads/ in cat-harness/.
findings: [term] 'bean yl5w' rendered as 'task', losing the repository's defined work-item term.

entries.msgid: A replica of a WHO IRIS page, rendered from this repository's ingested catalogue. Not WHO, and not live.
entries.msgstr: 世卫组织 IRIS 页面的副本，根据本存储库收录的目录生成。并非世卫组织网站，也非实时内容。
entries.back_translation: A replica of WHO IRIS pages, generated from the catalogue included in this repository. Not the WHO website, and not live content.
findings: [term] 'ingested catalogue' rendered as 'catalogue included in this repository', losing the term of art 'ingested'.
[sense] 'Not WHO' narrowed to 'Not the WHO website'.

entries.msgid: Addressing follows the owner’s rule — <base-url>/<path-to-kind-or-node> — so an instance that instantiates a directory gets a visualiser mounted under that directory’s kind: /library/who-iris/, /docs/who-iris/, and so on.
entries.msgstr: 寻址遵循所有者的规则——<base-url>/<path-to-kind-or-node>——因此，实例化某个目录的实例会获得一个挂载在该目录类型之下的可视化工具：/library/who-iris/、/docs/who-iris/ 等。
entries.back_translation: Addressing follows the owner's rule — <base-url>/<path-to-kind-or-node> — therefore an instance that instantiates a certain catalogue gets a visualization tool mounted under that catalogue type: /library/who-iris/, /docs/who-iris/, etc.
findings: [term] 'directory' / 'directory's kind' became 'catalogue' / 'catalogue type'; in this product 'catalogue' is a distinct defined object, so the owner's addressing rule (mount under a directory's kind, e.g. /library/, /docs/) now reads as being about catalogues.

entries.msgid: Ingested text (L1)
entries.msgstr: 收录的文本（L1）
entries.back_translation: Included text (L1)
findings: [term] 'Ingested text (L1)' rendered as 'Included text (L1)', losing the term of art 'ingested' (extracted into the library).

entries.msgid: No dc.description.abstract in the captured record.
entries.msgstr: 采集的记录中没有 dc.description.abstract。
entries.back_translation: There is no dc.description.abstract in the harvested record.
findings: [term] 'captured record' rendered as 'harvested record'; 'harvested' is a DSpace/OAI-PMH term of art with a different technical sense from capturing a record into the catalogue.

entries.msgid: none captured
entries.msgstr: 未采集
entries.back_translation: Not harvested
findings: [term] 'none captured' rendered as 'Not harvested'; 'harvested' carries the OAI-PMH technical sense, not 'captured'.

entries.msgid: none recorded — ingested from a local copy, not resolved from IRIS
entries.msgstr: 未记录——从本地副本收录，并非经 IRIS 解析
entries.back_translation: Not recorded — included from a local copy, not resolved via IRIS
findings: [term] 'ingested from a local copy' rendered as 'included from a local copy', losing the term of art 'ingested'.

entries.msgid: referenced
entries.msgstr: 仅引用
entries.back_translation: Reference only
findings: [term] the fixed state-badge name 'referenced' came back as 'Reference only'; the gloss fits the state's meaning, but the owner-fixed state name is no longer rendered as a term and may not match 'referenced' as used in strings 42 and 95.

entries.msgid: size upstream unknown — the storage report's second page was never read, and a number interpolated from the first would look measured
entries.msgstr: 上游容量未知——存储报告的第二页从未读取，而根据第一页推算的数字会显得像是实测值
entries.back_translation: Upstream capacity unknown — the second page of the storage report was never read, and a figure extrapolated from the first page would look like a measured value
findings: [sense] 'size upstream' became 'Upstream capacity' (maximum rather than actual size).
[sense] 'interpolated from the first' became 'extrapolated from the first page', a different estimation method.
